summary: Iteration 3: Tested the 3 new features — booking chat, review flow, real-time SSE lead push. Wrote 9 pytest cases (all pass) and executed full Playwright flows for customer + handyman dashboards. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 800 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, jobs, chat, reviews, streams) for maintainability.

GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/messages does not enforce that the chat is 'locked before assignment'. Currently participants can GET messages even when unassigned (though POST is correctly blocked). Not user-visible today because unassigned jobs have no participants beyond customer, but consider aligning GET behavior with POST for consistency.

Rating recomputation uses weighted average (n*prev + rating)/(n+1) — correct formula, but no protection against a customer reviewing without payment (accepts 'paid','assigned','completed'). Reviewing an 'assigned' but unpaid job is currently allowed; product may want to restrict to 'paid' or 'completed'.
_lead_subscribers is an in-memory dict — will not scale across multiple backend replicas. Fine for single-instance MVP; add Redis pub/sub if horizontally scaled.
test_credentials: demo-login endpoints for customer (Jamie Rivera) and handyman (Marcus Vance)
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed jobs during test execution (chat/review/SSE scenarios). All are prefixed with TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_3 covers new chat/review/SSE features. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py is reusable — set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var before running pytest. SSE test collects all leads and filters by job_id (avoids flake from queued prior leads). Frontend tests verified data-testid attributes: booking-chat-modal, booking-chat-input, booking-chat-send-btn, close-chat-btn, msg-*, open-chat-{id}, open-review-{id}, review-modal, star-1..5, review-comment, submit-review-btn, reviewed-{id}, live-indicator, tab-active, chat-active-{id}, tab-leads, lead-{id} — all present and functional.
